Caps move straight down, so a travel meeting a NEIGHBOUR's cap would mean the two overlap in plan, which drc.echo's cap-to-cap gap rule holds

UNUSED ALLOW RULES 5 - delete them or they will excuse the next clash
  MIDI jack  x  oak bottom   - the jack's thread and nut pass the oak bottom's through-hole, and its collar sits in the counterbore
  breath inlet barb  x  breath inlet insert   - the outer barb's #10-32 thread screws into the insert, drawn at the thread's major diameter in the insert's bore
  breath inner barb  x  breath inlet insert   - the inner barb's #10-32 thread screws into the insert from inside
  Matrix carrier screw *  x  Matrix carrier*   - each mount's screw passes up through its washer, the carrier's hole and its spacer into its insert, and threads into the insert (config/body.yaml hardware.mx_*)
  Matrix carrier screw *  x  oak top   - the screw's tip runs inside its insert's hole in the oak, which the insert lines
